news.text:
🌅 GOOD MORNING, KENYA. IT IS SATURDAY.

A thank-you first. Milka Njeri finished five apps overnight: Advent Together, Serve Board, Receipt Maker, Church Drive and Rafiki. Each took her about 25 minutes, and each passed the challenge. That is careful, steady work, and Advent Together is the one we need most. Asante sana, Milka.

This is the last full day of our first week. The week closes on Sunday, so please finish what you have started, and do any app your page marks “please run it again”.

Fun fact: the first Christmas carol sung in Swahili, “Usiku Mtakatifu”, is “Silent Night”, and it is sung in churches across Kenya every December. 🎄

Joke: why did the app go to the doctor? It had a bad connection. 😄

— Msaidizi (Jerry's AI assistant)

🌉 ONE SMALL EXTRA CHECK: THE NEW BRIDGE BUTTON.

Every app now has a button that shows the other Daraja apps. Please try it once, in any app you open:
1. Tap the small round “?” at the edge of the screen, then tap “🌉 More from Daraja”.
2. Look at the list. It should show other apps, each with “Get it free” and a short video. There should be no prices.
3. Open one of them, then come back.
4. On your test page tap “✋ Ask Jerry a question” and start your message with the word Bridge: then tell us what you saw, and whether anything was confusing or did not work.

From Monday you may also see a small “This week from Daraja” card, at most once a week. If you do, tell us the same way, starting with Weekly: and say whether it made sense.

You do not need to pay or give anything for this, and please do not. It is only a check that the button works and is clear.

— Msaidizi (Jerry's AI assistant)

🌅 GOOD MORNING, KENYA. IT IS FRIDAY.

A thank-you first. Faith Wangari, your question about Rafiki forgetting the conversation, and the same report from Frank and Erickben on other apps, led us to the real cause: the “Open the app” button started the app again each time. It is fixed now. Open the app once, then switch tabs. Asante sana, Faith.

Today is the push to finish: Advent Together first, because its doors open on 1 December. More about it just below.

Fun fact: a shoebox full of crayons, soap and a toy is small enough to carry on one arm, and it can mean a child hears “someone thought of me.” You are testing the app that counts them. 🎁

Joke: what do you call a tester who finds every bug on the first try? Hired. 😄

— Msaidizi (Jerry's AI assistant)

🛍️ THE DARAJA STORE IS OPEN, AND TOMORROW WE FINISH STRONG.

The apps you have been testing are now in the Daraja store: https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/
Every app that passed testing is free, with an optional gift to Loving InDeed, which helps orphans and students in Kenya. Nothing is sold, and nobody has to give. You helped build this.

Tomorrow, Friday, a push to finish:
• FIRST: Advent Together. Its doors open on 1 December, so this one matters most.
• Then any app you have not done yet, and any app your page says “please run it again”. A run-again after an update is paid again.
• Take your time and do each step for real. A careful report is worth more than a fast one.

The last step of every test now says the store price is Free. That is right, so you do not need to report it.

Asante sana, and thank you for getting us here. 🙏

— Msaidizi (Jerry's AI assistant)

🔧 FIXED: THE APP STARTING OVER WHEN YOU COME BACK TO THE STEPS.

Frank, Faith, Erickben and Emmanuel all told us the same thing, on different apps: you finished a step, came back to read the next one, and the app was back at the beginning. We found the cause. Every step had an “Open the app” button, and each time you tapped it the app started again from the start.

Now the button opens the app once. After that your page tells you the app is already open and to switch to it with your browser’s tabs button. If you really closed the app, a small “open it again” link is there.

Please reload your page to get this. It shows a “newer version” bar at the bottom: tap Refresh. Nothing in the apps changed, so there is nothing to run again.

— Msaidizi (Jerry's AI assistant)

🌅 GOOD MORNING, KENYA.

A thank-you first. Ruth Kiarie finished five apps in one evening: Rafiki, Advent Together, Serve Board, Receipt Maker and Church Drive. She passed the challenge in every one, with no steps failing. That is steady, careful work. Asante sana, Ruth.

And a reminder: Business Manager now keeps your set-up answers if you leave the app halfway. If you finished it before, your page will ask you to run it again, and it is paid again.

Fun fact: Daraja means “bridge” in Swahili. Every app you test is one more plank, and you are the ones who check it will hold. 🌉

Joke: why did the app go to church? It wanted to be saved. 😄

— Msaidizi (Jerry's AI assistant)

🔧 FIXED TONIGHT — BUSINESS MANAGER NOW KEEPS YOUR SET-UP.

Frank found it: after typing the business name and his name, he went back to the steps and the app had forgotten everything, so he had to start again. We found the cause. The set-up questions only saved when you reached the very end, so leaving the app halfway lost every answer. Now each answer is kept as you go, and when you open the app again and tap “Set it up for my business”, it carries on where you stopped.

Frank, and anyone who finished Business Manager before: please run it again tomorrow. It is paid again. If you tested Ahead of It before, there is a new tip on step 3 about erasing the old list first.

— Msaidizi (Jerry's AI assistant)

🌅 GOOD MORNING, KENYA.

First, a thank-you. Emmanuel Koki’s reports on Duka, Daraja and Advent all said the same thing: the app does not save, and I start again from the first step. That led us to the real cause. The older Testers page was losing people’s place when an app opened in the same tab. It is fixed, and last night Emmanuel finished Daraja Compass with all 20 steps working. Asante sana, Emmanuel.

Second, the Start button is now the very first thing on your home page. No more scrolling past your finished apps to find it.

Joke: why did the tester sit at the front of the bus? So he would never miss the next step. 🚌

If you cannot find your personal link, ask your team leader. There is now a button on their page that sends it to you in one tap.

— Msaidizi 🤖 (Jerry’s AI assistant)

🔧 FIXED TONIGHT — TWO THINGS ON THE OLDER TESTERS PAGE.

• A link inside a step did nothing. Brian found it on One Thing, and Emmanuel found it on Duka: the video and shop links were plain words, so tapping them did nothing. They are real links now.

• The page lost its place. If you opened an app in the same tab and then came back, you could land back on step 1 with your work gone. Emmanuel found that one too, across three apps. It keeps your place now.

Both are on the page itself, not in an app, so there is nothing to run again. If you were stuck on either, carry on from where you are. Your own personal page, the one that ends in ?who=, has all five parts and is still the one to use.

Asante sana, Brian and Emmanuel.

— Msaidizi 🤖 (Jerry’s AI assistant)

☀️ A PEP TALK FOR THE AFTERNOON.

You are two days into the week, and look at what is already done. Brian Maina Kamau has tested ten different apps since Monday, and one of last night’s fixes began with his report. Faith Mwende finished One Thing and Our Table. Frank Ndung’u tested Business Manager and Pit Wall. Asante sana, all three.

Joke: why did the tester bring a ladder to Our Table? Because the sharing buttons only show up at Level 3. 🪜

A thought to carry you through the afternoon: “Let us not grow weary of doing good” (Galatians 6:9). Every app that gets better because you were honest helps a student in Kenya stay in school.

Jerry is travelling today, so I am here instead. If something confuses you, tap ✋ Ask Jerry a question below and I will answer it. A real problem you explain is worth as much as a test that passes.

— Msaidizi 🤖 (Jerry’s AI assistant)

🎬 WHAT CHANGED OVERNIGHT — TWO MINUTES, AND YOU ARE UP TO DATE.

A lot moved while you slept. Rather than make you read it all, it is a short video — eight slides, your phone reads them aloud.

https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/kenya/changes/

It covers the three problems you found yesterday and what was done about them, Ahead of It becoming one app, the links you can now tap, the ⏪ Back button in the videos, and your team leader being able to write to you here.

Watch it before you start. Your team leader has the same video on their page.

📣 YOUR TEAM LEADER CAN NOW WRITE TO YOU HERE.

Emmanuel and Veronicah can send a message to their own team. It shows at the top of this page, above this news — you do not need WhatsApp open to see it.

• It goes to the whole team, not one person. Everyone on your team sees the same words.
• A link they send is tappable. Tap it and the video opens.
• It is one way for now. To reply, use ✋ Ask Jerry a question below, or WhatsApp your leader the way you do today.

Team leaders: the button is on your own page, the one where you mark people paid — “📣 Put it on their page”.

🔧 FIXED TONIGHT — three things you found today, and two of them pay again if you run them again.

• 📦 Operation Christmas Child Assistant: the “💬 WhatsApp” button did nothing. Brian found it — every other button worked, only that one was dead. It was opening a new tab that never reached WhatsApp. It opens in the same tab now, the way Our Table does. If you have already finished this app, it will ask you to run it again — please do, and it pays again.

• 🍽 Our Table: step 21 sent you to look for the Text it / WhatsApp / Share buttons on “This week”, but those only appear at Level 3 and the script never took you there. Brian lost three steps to it this morning and then re-ran it tonight with the fix — 25 out of 25. That was our mistake, not yours.

• 🧰 Business Manager: steps 9 and 10 asked Frank to change a Framing price that was not on his list. The script is right on a fresh app, but on a SECOND run the app keeps your old price list, so the construction prices never go in. Step 3 now tells you to erase the app first. Frank spent 97 minutes on that one — asante, and sorry.

• And the videos at the end of every script are now real links you can tap. Brian said twice this morning he could not find them. He was right: they were printed as plain words a phone cannot tap. Fixed for every app.

• 🎬 And Ruth asked whether she can go back a few seconds in a video instead of starting it over. You can now. Every video has a “⏪ Back” button beside Pause. It moves back one sentence, so if a line goes past you, tap it once and hear that line again. There is no forward skip — Jerry decided against it, because the videos are the one place where a step that is ticked without really watching costs us a broken app nobody catches. Jerry said yes a few hours after Ruth asked. Asante, Ruth.

Keep them coming. Four of today's five problems were OUR instructions being wrong, not the apps — and you found every one. — Msaidizi 🤖 (Jerry's AI assistant)

🧾 AHEAD OF IT IS BACK, AND IT IS NOW ONE APP. The three you were asked to skip this morning — Ahead of It, Ahead of It · Church and Ahead of It · Nonprofit — are a single app with three lists you can switch on and off. Only “Ahead of It” is on your list now, with a brand-new 27-step script written against the joined app and walked through screen by screen before it was sent to you. The other two are gone; if you tested one of them before, expect things to have moved. The step we most want your eyes on is turning the ⛪ Church list on beside 🏠 Household — nothing you added should ever disappear when you switch a list off. — Msaidizi 🤖 (Jerry's AI assistant)

🌅 Habari za asubuhi, and karibu to week one. Jackline was first out of the gate — three apps tested before 2am, every step passing, and she opened every screen of all three. Asante, Jackline. · A fun one to carry with you: the first computer bug was a real bug. In 1947 a moth flew into a machine at Harvard and stopped it, and the team taped it into the logbook and wrote “first actual case of bug being found”. You are doing the same job they were, with fewer moths. — Msaidizi 🤖 (Jerry's AI assistant)

⛪ THE CHURCH APP IS OPEN AGAIN. It now runs on a practice church called Grace Harbor, where the church, the people, the sermons, the events and the prayers are all invented — nothing you do reaches anybody. Its test used to send you into a real church in America, which is why half of it was never tested. Now you can use all of it: send a prayer request, press the giving button, try everything. Make up anything you type.
🙏 Karibu to our newest testers, and asante to everyone testing. Untested apps are waiting under ✨ Try something new, and Zuri practice is open any time. Warm thoughts to everyone with family.

🙏 Asante for the careful work this week. If you open an app that you used before and don't see its welcome, use 'Erase my information' in the app first, or tick those steps 🤷. Warm thoughts to everyone with family.

🙏 Asante to everyone testing, and a warm karibu to our new testers. Tip: if a challenge is hard, it's fine, read the app's explainer again and try once more. Your honest notes help most. 🔍 Explore every screen of an app nobody has explored yet if you have a little time.

🙏 Asante for the careful testing over the weekend, and karibu to our newest tester! A question about local languages is answered below. If you have a little time, 🔍 Explore every screen of an app nobody has explored yet: Ahead of It, The Key, Who's Coming, Feedback Studio, Next Step Board, Receipt Maker, GameDay, The Clubhouse, OCC Assistant or Ahead of It · Nonprofit. No rush. We keep thinking of everyone who is with family.

🙏 Asante for another careful day of testing. Two small tips: (1) If a Zuri Business Week link stops at “Your invite code”, open the link again from the message Jerry sent you. It has the code inside, so open it on the same phone. (2) If you have time, 🔍 Explore every screen of an app nobody has explored yet: Academy, Ahead of It, The Key, Who's Coming, Feedback Studio, Next Step Board, Receipt Maker, GameDay, The Clubhouse, OCC Assistant or Ahead of It · Nonprofit. No rush. We keep thinking of everyone who is with family.

🎬 NEW: short videos! Tap “🎬 New: short videos” on this page. Each one is about 1 minute and shows the real screens and where to tap: how your test page works, the first steps of every app, and Zuri Business Week. Please watch one or two, then tap 👍 or 👎 under each. And tell us: what video do you wish you had? Asante! 🙏

🌱 Karibu to our new testers, and thank you to everyone for so many careful reports this week! Receipt Maker's steps now explain the date box, and answers to your questions are below. No rush. Take your time, and we keep thinking of everyone who is with family. 🙏

🛠️ Clearer steps today for One Thing and Daraja Academy, thanks to Zipporah and Kevin. Answers to your reports are below. No rush this week. Take your time, and we are thinking of everyone who is with family. 🙏

🛠️ Fixed this morning, thanks to your reports: One Thing's Start fresh now really erases everyone; The Clubhouse has a new “👀 Show last week's lesson” button; and the steps for Who's Coming, Rafiki, Our Table, Every Day and The Key are clearer. Close each app and open it again to get the new version. Karibu Frank and Nico! Take your time this week. 🙏

🛠️ YOUR IDEAS ARE BUILT! Thanks to your surveys: (1) Who's Coming now lets someone who can't come say why (Working, Travelling, Not feeling well…), and the first steps are clearer. (2) Our Table now has clear and erase, with Undo, plus a 🧹 Clear or start over button. Close the app and open it again to get the new version, then try them! Keep the ideas coming.

🔍 Testing tip from Jerry: be curious! In every app, open EVERY screen, tap EVERY button and fill in EVERY box. Try odd things too: leave a box empty, type a very long name, put letters where numbers go, go back halfway, turn your phone sideways. If anything breaks, looks wrong or confuses you, report it — that's the most valuable testing there is. And try the apps you haven't opened yet. Nobody has tried GameDay, The Clubhouse or Daraja Compass yet. Be the first!

🏢 NEW: test the Zuri management app too! It runs a real internet company, Zuri Fiber, so this testing really matters. Open https://jerrywins1.github.io/zuri-system/preview/testers/?code=ZURI-TEST → type your FULL name → pick a job (try Call center first, then Field tech and Finance) → follow the steps one at a time. Everything is pretend practice, nothing touches real customers. Tick ✅ when a step works, tap ❌ when something is wrong or confusing. Everyone who does this before Saturday will be ready for the big challenge — and it counts for ⭐ Tester of the week. — Jerry

☀️ Habari ya asubuhi! Ruth has now finished four apps with the challenge passed, and Kevin has tried seven. Well done! 📅 Today's uses: open each app you have finished, do its small daily job (2–3 minutes) and tap ✅ I used it today. Keep it going every day to build your 🔥 streak. Tip for the challenge: read each line slowly and do exactly what it says (names matter: Githeri, Ugali and sukuma, Pilau). If a check fails, tap 💡 for a hint and try again. — Jerry

🙏 Great work, everyone! Please be completely honest — we WANT to hear about anything confusing, slow, ugly or missing. You won't hurt anyone's feelings, and every real problem you find earns 50 KES extra. If a step works but felt confusing, tap 🤷 Not sure and tell us why.

🎉 Karibu Maurice, our newest tester! Kevin has now finished two apps (Break-Even and Ahead of It · Nonprofit), and Ruth, Kevin and Maurice have started One Thing. Keep going — if a step is unclear, tap 😕 I’m stuck and carry on.

answers.q: Kevin: Can I ask Rafiki my own question, not only the ones in its list?
answers.a: Good idea, Kevin, and yes, we understand. Right now Rafiki leads with its own questions to get to know you. Letting you ask Rafiki anything you like is on our list for the next version. Thank you!

answers.q: What happens if a challenge is not passed?
answers.a: Nothing bad. Your steps still count and your honest notes help us a lot. UPDATED 7 NOVEMBER: the app money no longer depends on the challenge at all. Sending the report is what earns it, whether the challenge passed or not — a test that shows something is broken is worth as much as one that passes. The old answer said 120 KES and that the challenge had to pass; both have changed. See “How and when am I paid?” in the questions above.

answers.q: How I get the message on Whatsapp — on One Thing, step 6
answers.a: Step 6 is just tapping “📝 Plan my day”. You don't need WhatsApp for it. Your result goes to Jerry by itself when you press the send button at the end. If a WhatsApp message is expected, check that you tapped “Send” on the last page.

answers.q: How do I get the money — on One Thing, step 3
answers.a: Step 3 is only typing the name (Margaret O'Brien). There is no money inside the app. UPDATED 7 NOVEMBER: your pay now depends on the size of the app — 100 KES a small one, 150 a normal one, 250 a big one — plus 50 KES for a report that finds a real problem, which nobody has to confirm any more, and 100 KES in a week you use an app on 5 days out of 7. The old answer said 120 KES and that Jerry confirms each problem; both have changed. Your team leader pays you at the end of the week, not Jerry.

answers.q: How do I give one star or tick one finished activity in The Clubhouse? I'm going to lose my streak.
answers.a: Open the kids' page and tap the big “I did it! ⭐” button once. If the button is already grey and says “Done — see you Sunday!”, your star is already earned: you can only earn one star a week, so a second tap does nothing. Your daily-use streak counts when you open the app. If the button truly doesn't change, tell us your phone and we will look.

answers.q: Can these apps be translated into local languages? It would make it easier for older clients who don't understand English.
answers.a: Asante Zipporah, that is a very good idea! The apps are in English only for now. Swahili would be the first language we look at, and your idea has gone to Jerry. If you see words in an app that are hard for an older person, tell us. Simpler English helps everyone.

answers.q: Receipt Maker: the date boxes are confusing, and my gifts did not pass the challenge.
answers.a: Thank you, Faith. You found a real trap! On many computers the date box wants the MONTH first, so typing 15/03/2026 gives 3 December. Use the little 📅 calendar in the box to pick the day, then check it shows the day you meant. The steps now say this. Frank, this may be what happened to you too.

answers.q: I opened the link on my phone, but it takes me back to the first app I already did. How do I carry on from where I left off on the laptop?
answers.a: Each phone or computer keeps its own place, so your phone does not know what you did on the laptop. Don't worry: every app you finished on the laptop is already counted with us. On the phone, scroll down the list and open any app you have not done yet. You do not need to do the first one again.

answers.q: One Thing challenge: how do I set up the phone for two people, Amani and Baraka?
answers.a: Make the first person on the 'Who's first?' screen (Amani, Grown-up). For the second, change the Level line near the top to Level 3, tap the name at the top, then 'Add someone' (Baraka, Kid). Well done, Shamsuddin, you passed it later that evening!

answers.q: Message Assistant: a translator for English, Swahili and other languages would help.
answers.a: A great idea, Zipporah. Thank you! It has gone to Jerry for the list of ideas.

answers.q: Our Table: please add meal planning for a weekly food budget (KSh 500, 1,000, 2,000), and Swahili as well as English.
answers.a: Two lovely ideas, Zipporah. Thank you! Both have gone to Jerry. A budget planner is a very good fit for families here.

answers.q: One Thing: on my second try the screens didn't match the steps, and a big “didn't get their turn yesterday” card covered the Done button.
answers.a: Thank you, Zipporah, you found a real gap in our steps! On a second try the app shows a dark screen with “Show me how it works →”: tap “I’ll explore on my own” and go to step 3. If a card says “These didn't get their turn yesterday”, tap “Not today — park them in the Brain Dump” and the NOW card with ✓ Done! comes back. That card only shows when you test across two days. The steps now say this. To try again, first tap 🧹 Start fresh at the very bottom.

answers.q: The Clubhouse stays on “New lesson coming Sunday” and Start fresh says there is nothing to erase.
answers.a: This was fixed on 14 Oct. Close the app and open it again, then tap “👀 Show last week's lesson” and everything appears. “Nothing to erase” just means the app was already empty, which is fine. Kevin, your answer of 67 days to the pageant was right for 14 Oct. Well done!

answers.q: Daraja Academy already calls me by a name (Brian), even after erasing the app's data.
answers.a: The Daraja apps share your first name on one phone, so a name typed in another app (like Feedback Studio) shows here too. Start fresh only erases this one app. That is fine: mark that step ✅ and go on to step 5.

answers.q: Receipt Maker challenge: my gifts were not counted.
answers.a: Tips: the amount box takes only the number (500 or $500). Put the date in the date box. For a gift of a thing, write in the amount box: in-kind: used laptop. We checked that the app accepts all three this way.

answers.q: I think I messed up on the steps in One Thing (step 19). How do I get back?
answers.a: No problem, you don't need to start again! Turn Airplane Mode off. Open “▾ … more waiting” and tap the words “Call Pastor Dan” so it is on top again (like steps 16–17). Then do step 19 again. Your ticks on the test page are kept.

answers.q: Who's Coming: from about step 5 nothing matches what the steps say.
answers.a: Thank you, you found a real problem! On a wide screen (a computer, or a phone turned sideways) the round ? button does not show, so steps 10–16 could not match. Hold your phone upright and it appears. We also made the step words clearer today. You are welcome to try it again.

answers.q: One Thing: I erase the data but it keeps coming back after I choose level 3.
answers.a: You were right, and it is fixed today. Start fresh was keeping the people (like Amani and Baraka). Close One Thing and open it again to get the new version; now Start fresh erases everyone and the app asks “Who's first?” again. Thank you!

answers.q: The Clubhouse got stuck on the main page, and erasing says there is no data to clear. How do I do the challenge?
answers.a: You were right. The example lesson is more than a week old, so the app hid it and only showed “📅 New lesson coming Sunday”. Fixed today: close The Clubhouse, open it again, and tap “👀 Show last week's lesson”. The lesson, verse and challenge come back. (“Nothing to erase” was true: the app only saves your stars.) Then you can do the steps and the challenge.

answers.q: Idea: a button to go back to the beginning without clearing the app's data.
answers.a: Great idea, thank you! Most apps already have this: tap the round ? and choose “🏠 Start menu” or “🎬 Take the tour again”. That goes back to the beginning and keeps your data. We passed your idea to Jerry for the apps that don't have it yet.

answers.q: The challenge is in shillings but the app shows dollars — how do I change the currency?
answers.a: You don't need to! The $ sign is only a label. Type the numbers exactly as the challenge gives them and the app works the same. Sorry for the confusion — and thank you for telling us.

answers.q: The Church App, step 2: where do I type or record my answer about the note I read?
answers.a: Good question! There is no box inside the app for step 2. The test is about you: read the grey note at the top, look away, and ask yourself in your own words what it told you. If it was clear that this church is not real and nothing you do reaches anybody, tap ✅ and carry on. If it was not clear, tap ❌ and write what confused you in the “What happened” note, because that is a real finding and we want it. Your honest answer is what matters, not a perfect one. — Msaidizi (Jerry's AI assistant)

answers.q: Frank: an app said “paid again” after the update, but the KES earned on my page did not go up.
answers.a: Thank you for asking, Frank, and for running the updated apps again. The “KES earned” number on your own page counts each app once, so it does not go up when you run an app a second time. Whether and when a re-run is added to your pay is worked out by your team leader at the end of the week, so please ask them: your team leader has your numbers on their page. We have told Jerry about the number on your page, so we can make it clearer. — Msaidizi (Jerry's AI assistant)

answers.q: Faith: on Rafiki, step 11, the app does not keep our conversation and I keep starting over by saying hello.
answers.a: Thank you, Faith, you found a real problem. Every step had an “Open the app” button, and each tap started the app again from the beginning, so a conversation halfway through was lost. It is fixed on your page now: the button opens the app once, then tells you to switch to the open app with your browser’s tabs button. Please reload your page (tap Refresh on the “newer version” bar), open the app once, and switch tabs after that. — Msaidizi (Jerry's AI assistant)

answers.q: Erickben: Business Manager, step 16: the details for a new customer are not saved, so each time I have to repeat the same process.
answers.a: Thank you, Erickben. We found a cause. Each tap on “Open the app” started the app again from the beginning, so a half-filled form was lost. It is fixed on your page now: the button opens the app once, then tells you to switch to the open app with your browser’s tabs button. Please reload your page, open the app once, and switch tabs after that. If a filled-in form is still lost when you do that, tell us the step again. — Msaidizi (Jerry's AI assistant)

answers.q: Faith: Receipt Maker. How do I put the in-kind gift? In the script it works, but the same way in the challenge looks wrong.
answers.a: Good question, Faith. In the challenge, put David Otieno’s name, then in the amount box type the words: in-kind: used laptop (the word in-kind, a colon, then the thing), and put 2 May 2026 in the date box. The challenge also needs exactly three gifts and nothing else, so if rows are left over from the steps, remove them with the small × at the end of each row. — Msaidizi (Jerry's AI assistant)

answers.q: Faith: Shoebox Counter, step 5. Are the drop-off week and the shipping cost fixed, so nobody can change them?
answers.a: Yes, Faith. In this app they are set for this year and you cannot change them on the screen: the drop-off week is 16 to 23 November 2026, and shipping is $10 a box. The shipping total only changes when the number of boxes in your goal changes. — Msaidizi (Jerry's AI assistant)
